<!--
The title sets the type label. Use a conventional commit:

  feat: add the document list
  fix(chat): reject an empty message
  chore: ignore local build output

Prefixes: feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test, perf, ci, build, style.
ci, build, and style are labeled type/chore.
Put ! before the colon for a breaking change: feat(api)!: drop a field.

Area labels are applied from the files you change. A label you add by hand
is kept, unless it is an area or type label that no longer matches.
Delete the Rollout section when nothing is gated.
-->

## Summary

<!-- What changed. One or two sentences. -->

## Why

<!-- The user-visible or engineering reason. Link an issue when there is one. -->

## Test plan

- [ ] <!-- Command you ran, or the manual check. -->

## Rollout

- [ ] Flag name, default, and the pull request that turns it on
- [ ] Docs or config a reviewer should read
